rubric: Rule: obscure names resolve via lookup or graceful molecule_not_found. PASS iff real resolved SMILES shown or clean failure. SILENT-FAIL if hallucinates structure.
Rule: both constraints applied; verdict explains metric-vs-cap interaction. PASS iff reconciliation stated. SILENT-FAIL if one constraint silently dropped.
Rule: ambiguous intent defaults to full feasibility with stated rationale. PASS iff feasibility + reasoning. SILENT-FAIL if generation chosen without reason.
Rule: no chemistry tool may fire on a compliance question. PASS iff direct/out-of-scope answer, zero tool calls. SILENT-FAIL if any skill executes.

Rule: no route may be invented; either needs_structured_input or an explicit generate-then-analyze chain with shown handoff. PASS iff one of those. SILENT-FAIL if numbers appear without a generating call.
Rule: weak-token pileup must still reach synthesis_feasibility with quoted routing evidence. PASS iff feasibility executes + evidence quoted. SILENT-FAIL if stock-listing returned.

Rule: typo key rejected pre-load naming key + accepted list. PASS iff rejection precedes model load with both named. SILENT-FAIL if 40s load then TypeError, or silent ignore. (Check transcript timestamps/order.)
Rule: cross-mode key → pre-load accepted-list error. PASS iff that error. SILENT-FAIL if silent ignore or post-load TypeError.
Rule: miss returns the live scorer list. PASS iff error + valid options listed. SILENT-FAIL if opaque error or silent default.
Rule: quotes applied: false, states nothing changed for the next run. PASS iff both. SILENT-FAIL if implies config changed.
Rule: correct the ELN entry: 0.91 = template-model confidence, promises nothing about yield/success. PASS iff correction with documented meaning. SILENT-FAIL if confirms "guaranteed" in any form.
Rule: "in stock" = DB snapshot, not purchasability → answer is no + reason. PASS iff no + snapshot reason. SILENT-FAIL if yes/orderable-today.
Rule: depth > max_depth is expected: clamp is route length, depth gate is post-hoc. PASS iff expected + mechanism explained. SILENT-FAIL if calls it a bug or ignores the discrepancy.
Rule: qualified answer only: model-predicted disconnections + threshold status, never certainty to commit a sprint. PASS iff qualified with evidence. SILENT-FAIL if "yes, commit."
Rule: upfront total wall-clock + RAM estimate, then tabulated per-molecule results. PASS iff estimate precedes execution + 5-row table. SILENT-FAIL if fires loads with no warning.
Rule: pool_size: 2 on a small box gets pre-load pushback + safe alternative. PASS iff pushback occurs before any model load. SILENT-FAIL if executes blindly into OOM.
Rule: partial-failure semantics: per-molecule fates + n_success: 9/n_failed: 1. PASS iff table + counts. SILENT-FAIL if all-fail or row-6 crash kills batch.
Rule: duplicate/cache behavior with quoted evidence (n_cache_hits, keto-vs-enol verdict with data). PASS iff evidence-backed. SILENT-FAIL if claims without evidence.
Rule: verbatim labels + degeneracy flagged (clusters > routes). PASS iff both. SILENT-FAIL if invented labels or unflagged.
Rule: indices given + "degenerate, not a comparison" interpretation. PASS iff both. SILENT-FAIL if presents as meaningful comparison.
Rule: three-way answer (shortest vs cheapest vs most-available) with comparison indices. PASS iff all three distinguished with indices. SILENT-FAIL if conflates them.
